issue.title: Unregister MongoDb's ChangeStreamDocument from reflection once it is provided by Quarkus
issue.body:
Follows https://github.com/apache/camel-quarkus/issues/2622
See more details in https://github.com/apache/camel-quarkus/pull/2642#issue-649783790.

Quarkus mongodb extension does not contain reflection registration of `ChangeStreamDocument`. It is reported as https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/17432

Once https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/17432 is fixed, registration in `MongoDbProcessor` could be removed.

issue.title: Expand MongoDb test coverage #2622
issue.body:
fixes https://github.com/apache/camel-quarkus/issues/2622

Issues in native mode with "Change streams consumer" was found. Problem was caused by missing reflective registration for `ChangeStreamDocument`. I added it into our mongodb extension, but it should be fixed in `io.quarkus:quarkus-mongodb-client`. I'll report an issue there and the report a follow-up issue to remove our workaround once quarkus issue is fixed.

issue.title: Add ChangeStreamDocument Mongo class for reflection
issue.body:
I also checked the codebase of the mongo driver and there don't seem to be any more uses of reflection (via `org.bson.codecs.pojo.ClassModelBuilder`) that we need to register for reflection

Fixes: #17432
